objectives.title: Data Erasure Timelines
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding timelines for executing erasure requests.
criteria: Commitment to erase personal data without undue delay.
Defined turnaround times for processing customer deletion instructions.
Procedures for confirming data deletion completion.

objectives.title: Data Deletion Triggers
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding triggers for personal data deletion.
criteria: Deletion triggered when personal data exceeds original necessity.
Deletion triggered upon customer consent withdrawal notifications.
Deletion triggered following valid customer processing objections.
Deletion triggered by unlawful processing determinations.
Deletion triggered by statutory Union legal mandates.
Deletion triggered by withdrawal of a child's consent to information society services under Article 8(1).

objectives.title: Downstream Replication Notification
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding notifications to third parties concerning replicated personal data.
criteria: Technical measures informing third-party controllers regarding erasure requests.
Procedures identifying links to erased data.
Procedures identifying copies of erased data.
Procedures identifying replications of erased data.

objectives.title: Retention Exceptions
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding exemptions from deletion obligations.
criteria: Retention permissions justified by legal obligations, public-interest tasks, or official authority.
Retention permissions justified by public health reasons.
Retention permissions supporting archiving, scientific, historical research, or statistical purposes.
Retention permissions supporting the exercise of freedom of expression and information.
Retention permissions supporting the establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims.
